title: Timeline strip
subject: English
unit: Summer 2: Time Traveller and Off with Her Head!
source: Written for english/y5 lesson 88 (Timeline strip (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 88: Chapters 2 and 3: the clock strikes thirteen (timeline and prediction). Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: Reading chapters 2 and 3
points: Notice where Tom goes at night

timeline.text: Peter catches measles; Tom is sent away
Tom arrives at the flat in the big old house
He sees the old grandfather clock in the hall
At night, he hears the clock strike thirteen
He goes downstairs and finds a garden that is not there by day

parts.text: Clue: the garden appears only then
Prediction: Tom will return every night
Because: he is curious and lonely by day

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: I predict Tom will go back to the garden every night, because he is lonely in the flat and the garden is a mystery he wants to solve.

keywords.def: a tall clock that stands on the floor and chimes
something strange that cannot easily be explained
a woman who owns a house and lets rooms or flats

questions.a: Mrs Bartholomew, the old landlady upstairs

questions.q: What is unusual about the clock?
Core: complete a timeline of eight key events from chapters 1 to 3
Extend: write a prediction for chapter 4 with two clues
questions.a: A prediction supported by two clues

questions.q: Stretch: why do you think the author chose thirteen, not twelve?
questions.a: Thirteen is impossible on a normal clock, so it signals magic or another time

options: by day there is only a small yard
questions.a: A) by day there is only a small yard. The garden is only there at night, after the thirteenth strike; by day the back of the house is a small yard.
